learnings.question: Approximately what percentage of newly learned information is forgotten within 24 hours unless active recall is practiced, as demonstrated by Hermann Ebbinghaus?
learnings.learning: Hermann Ebbinghaus demonstrated that humans forget approximately 80% of newly learned information within 24 hours unless they actively force themselves to recall it.
learnings.articleTitle: Is Your Brain the Worst Place to Store Ideas? Why I Built a Second One

learnings.question: Which statistical concept served as the primary motivation for investigating whether learning the top 20 most frequent words would account for 80% of the Quran's content?
learnings.learning: The Pareto Principle (the 80/20 rule) served as the primary motivation for the study, testing whether mastering the top 20 words could yield an understanding of 80% of the Quran with minimal effort.
learnings.articleTitle: Top 20 Words to Understand the Quran: A Data Analysis using Python

learnings.question: What is the primary focus of the Sprint Review ceremony in Scrum?
options: To demonstrate completed work to the Product Owner and discuss improvements for future Sprints
To protect the development team from external distractions and resolve team impediments
To select user stories from the Product Backlog and produce a Sprint Backlog
To hold a brief daily meeting to discuss ongoing progress, plans, and blockers
learnings.learning: In Scrum, the Sprint Review ceremony serves to demonstrate completed work to the Product Owner and allow the team to reflect on the Sprint to identify improvements for future Sprints.

learnings.question: When an individual exercises free will and supplication to actively change their life circumstances, which aspect of destiny are they altering?
learnings.learning: Individuals hold the responsibility to influence and alter their Qada’ (the actual unfolding of life events) through their actions and supplications, even though every change is already eternally known and written in Allah's Qadr.
learnings.articleTitle: The Art of Qada’ and Qadr

learnings.question: What is the fundamental operational trade-off when a PCIe device transitions across the spectrum into deeper power management states (from L0 to L2)?
options: Achieving greater energy savings in exchange for longer wake-up times
Enhancing system responsiveness in exchange for reduced maximum bandwidth
Increasing data transmission speed in exchange for higher idle voltage
Reducing hardware longevity in exchange for lower standby heat
learnings.learning: PCIe power management regulates energy consumption across a spectrum of states ranging from active (L0) to deep sleep (L2), systematically trading wake-up responsiveness for greater power savings based on link inactivity.
learnings.articleTitle: Power Management States in the context of PCIe
